full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1-4 contested the suit by filing a joint written statements alleging, inter alia, that the suit land being khal category land has been under the possession of local people and the same has been recorded as khas land under SA Khatian No.1 and the same not having been fit for cultivation, the settlement No. 988(XIII)70-71 in favour of Mofizuddin in LA case was not legal and valid and the same was rightly cancelled and the land was rightly taken back in khas khatian of the government; that the plaintiff have no right, title and possession over the suit land and their kabalas being collusive, invalid and without valuable consideration, they are not entitled to get relief in the suit which is liable to be dismissed with cost.
